title: BoJ Minutes — September 17-18, 2026 MPM (no Outlook Report)
source: EST: boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/ ('Monetary Policy Meetings'), fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 41,959 bytes) and parsed cell-by-cell out of its two year tables by this session. Against the header 'Date of MPM | Outlook Report (The Bank's View) | Summary of Opinions | MPM Minutes', the 2026 September row parses exactly as ['Sept. 17 (Thurs.), 18 (Fri.)', '-', 'Oct. 1 (Thurs.)', 'Nov. 5 (Thurs.)'] — i.e. the full Minutes of the September 2026 MPM publish 2026-11-05, and that meeting carried NO Outlook Report (its column reads '-'). The same page states the release time verbatim: 'MPM Minutes It will be released at 8:50 a.m.', which is 08:50 JST Thu 2026-11-05 = 18:50 EST Wed 2026-11-04; corroborated from a released document's own embargo line, the Oct 29-30 2025 Minutes PDF opening 'Not to be released until 8:50 a.m. Japan Standard Time on Wednesday, December 24, 2025.' Filed estimate on two counts, identical to the ten BoJ entries already on this calendar: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: for the Federal Reserve and no slot for the Bank of Japan, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep.
notes: DISCOVERED during the boj-minutes-2026-12-23 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), off the same already-parsed schedule table, and filed as one half of a pair with boj-summary-of-opinions-2026-11-10 because together they are the LIVE 2026 INSTANCE of the schedule law that ledger settled. That law, tested this session against all eleven Minutes year-archives and all eleven Summary-of-Opinions year-archives (85 Minutes, 86 Summaries, 2016-2026, joined on meeting into 84 consecutive pairs): the Minutes of meeting N-1 publish BEFORE the Summary of Opinions of meeting N, 84/84 with zero inversions, gap median 5 days, mode exactly 5 (45/84). Here N-1 is the September MPM and N is the October MPM: these Minutes on Nov. 5 and that meeting's Summary on Nov. 10 are exactly 5 days apart, the modal value. The BoJ therefore publishes the older, roughly five-times-longer record before the newer digest — by design, not coincidence. This entry also closes a thread two sibling ledgers opened: boj-decision-2026-09-18's research left the September Summary unresolved between 'Oct. 1' and '09-28' because the table's offset structure made both readable, and boj-decision-2026-10-30 settled it by column-parsing the raw table (Sept SoO is Oct. 1; Sept Minutes are Nov. 5; Sept. 28 is the July 30-31 Minutes). Nov. 5 was named in that correction but never filed as an entry. Impact is LOW and the reasons are the ones every BoJ meeting-account entry carries: symbols is empty, no house playbook is rates- or FX-keyed, the channel to this calendar's AI names runs through yen funding and global term premium (both second-order, both already owned by the FOMC ledgers), and the document is by then a 48-day-old account of a meeting already superseded by the Oct 29-30 decision six days earlier. The September MPM carried no Outlook Report, so unlike the 12-23 document these Minutes contain no Outlook-drafting record — the one content an October-cohort Minutes uniquely carries. The 11-05 US session is separately crowded: it carries productivity-costs-q3-2026-11-05 (medium, CONFIRMED) that same morning, and it sits two days after the 2026-11-03 midterm elections (high) and the day after ism-services-2026-11-04 (high) and treasury-refunding-2026-11-04, so nothing in that tape is attributable to Tokyo without ruling those out first.
